name: edisource
description: Edisource is the AI-powered publishing platform built for newsrooms and editorial teams. Connect the Edisource account you already have, and Claude can work right alongside your desk: search and open drafts, suggest block-by-block edits that wait in Content Studio for your approval, build and refine prompt templates, run a template from a link or your notes, and summarize or set up Discover feeds. When your team turns it on, Claude can also search your CMS and publish a draft. Admins decide what Claude can do from Edisource Settings.
